purpose: Demonstrate Modal hard-memory-limit enforcement for the M3.6 function shape with a below-limit and an above-limit control; no labels, model, checkpoint, workload or quality evaluation
provider_retry_note: Modal may retry an input whose container failed. Provider retries of the above-limit control are counted from the provider export and recorded; DEMONSTRATED requires exactly one successful and one failed input, and every container beyond the below one must have errored. Any completed above-limit attempt is ENFORCEMENT_NOT_DEMONSTRATED. If the below control fails, the above control is not invoked.
cost_enforcement: One app, single-use containers, max_containers=1, 300 s function timeout, 900 s whole-app watchdog and app stop; no provider per-run hard dollar cap.
namespace_policy: create-once, preserve failure; no rerun authorized by this record
